etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 高 (phonetic コウ) — originally straw; the rough straw-stage of writing: a draft.
mnemonic: Writing still in the husk — コウ. 原稿: the manuscript, deadline attached.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 交 (phonetic コウ) — cords crossed and twisted tight: to wring, strangle.
mnemonic: The towel twisted to its last drop — しぼる. 絞る: also what exams do to brains.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 岡 (phonetic コウ) — the master rope: hawser; the guiding line: principle (綱領).
mnemonic: The rope everything else is tied to — つな. 綱引き: tug-of-war on the main line.

etymology: Compound: the balance beam carried level between (行) — the crossbar of scales: equilibrium.
mnemonic: The beam that must not tip — コウ. 均衡: balance, treaty-grade.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + 貝 — goods sent up to the court: tribute; to contribute (貢献).
mnemonic: The wagon of goods heading to the capital — みつぐ. 貢献: tribute turned teamwork.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 冓 (phonetic コウ) — structured buying: to purchase.
mnemonic: Money exchanged through the lattice — コウ. 購入: the checkout kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 孝 (phonetic コウ) — the brew working: fermentation, yeast.
mnemonic: The jar's dutiful bubbling — コウ. 発酵: bread, miso, and time.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + head (頁) — originally the nape; each 'head' of a text: item, clause.
mnemonic: Every heading gets its number — コウ. 項目: the list's skeleton.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 岡 (phonetic ゴウ) + blade (刂) — hard as a tempered edge: stalwart.
mnemonic: Ridge-hard steel — ゴウ. 金剛: diamond-hard, temple-guardian grade.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 考 (phonetic ゴウ) — interrogation by force: torture.
mnemonic: 考's dark interrogation twin — ゴウ. 拷問: the word history apologizes for.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 豕 — originally the bristling porcupine: formidable, magnificent; Australia (豪州).
mnemonic: The boar in the high hall — ゴウ. 豪華: grandeur with bristles.

etymology: Pictograph: a figure bearing a heavy helm and standing anyway — to prevail: overcome.
mnemonic: Carrying ten (十) troubles and still walking — コク. 克服: the comeback kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 告 (phonetic コク) — liquor harsh on the throat: severe, cruel.
mnemonic: The vintage that punishes — コク. 残酷: cruelty, and 酷暑: August.

etymology: Compound: two dogs (犭,犬) snarling over testimony (言) — the lawsuit's end: prison.
mnemonic: Guard dogs on both sides of the deposition — ゴク. 地獄: the prison below all prisons.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a rooting-beast phonetic + earth (土) — wild land clawed open: to break ground.
mnemonic: Claws before plows — コン. 開墾: the frontier verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 艮 (phonetic コン) — the heart that won't let go: grudge.
mnemonic: The splinter kept on purpose — うらむ. 恨み: grievance with a shrine.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + heart (心) — the heart worked over thoroughly: earnest, intimate.
mnemonic: Sincerity that digs in — コン. 懇親会: the bonding banquet.

etymology: Compound: the swarm under the sun (日) lined up (比) — multitudes: descendants; the swarming class: insects (昆虫).
mnemonic: Rows of little lives in the light — コン. 昆布: kelp, the sea's crowd.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 甘 (phonetic コン) — cloth dyed deepest indigo: navy.
mnemonic: Indigo steeped until sweet-dark — コン. 紺色: the school-uniform sea.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 云 (phonetic コン) + 鬼 — the spirit-breath of the dead: soul.
mnemonic: The vapor the ghost is made of — たましい. 大和魂: the national soul, capital S.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 夋 (phonetic サ) — whispered urging: to instigate.
mnemonic: The voice at your shoulder with bad ideas — そそのかす. 示唆: its respectable cousin — suggestion.

etymology: Compound ideograph: water (氵) + 少 — stone worn few and fine by water: sand (the elegant twin of 砂).
mnemonic: What the river leaves when it's done — サ. ご無沙汰: 'long silence' — sand gathered on the correspondence.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 乍 (phonetic サ) — words cut to deceive: fraud.
mnemonic: A story carved to fit your wallet — サ. 詐欺: the phone call to hang up on.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + a phonetic — links locked in series: chain; to close off (鎖国).
mnemonic: Small rings holding like money holds people — くさり. 鎖国: the chained country era.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 責 (phonetic サイ) — obligation personified: debt, bond.
mnemonic: 責 with a co-signer — サイ. 国債: the nation's IOU.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 崔 (phonetic サイ) — pressing something into happening: to hold, urge (催促).
mnemonic: The one who makes the event exist — もよおす. 開催: doors open, banners up.

etymology: Compound: the knife-and-needle work of the household (宀) — the steward who runs it: to manage.
mnemonic: The sharp one under the roof who decides — サイ. 主宰: running the show.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 采 (phonetic サイ) + 彡 'strokes' — hues laid on: coloring.
mnemonic: Three brushstrokes of gathered color — いろどる. 色彩: the palette's formal name.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 𢦏 (phonetic サイ) + tree (木) — trees set out with care: to cultivate.
mnemonic: Pruned into art — サイ. 盆栽: the tree kept bonsai-small.

etymology: Pictograph: a hand plucking from a tree — gathering; the gathered look of things: mien; the tossed lot: dice (采配).
mnemonic: The hand that picks — and the general's baton it became — サイ. 采配を振る: calling the plays.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 碎): stone (石) + a phonetic — broken to bits: to crush.
mnemonic: Rock reduced to gravel — くだく. 粉砕: pulverized — arguments included. Your seventh CS-Kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 斉 (phonetic サイ) — abstinence before rites: purification; the quiet room for it: a study (書斎).
mnemonic: Cleansed, quiet, shelved with books — サイ. 書斎: the room this kanji would live in.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 𢦏 (phonetic サイ) + cart (車) — set aboard: to load; set into print: to publish (掲載).
mnemonic: Cargo on the cart, articles on the page — のせる. 記載: loaded into the record.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 斉 'even' (phonetic ザイ) + blade (刂) — medicine cut to even doses: a preparation.
mnemonic: The pharmacist's even portions — ザイ. 洗剤: the cleaning agent under your sink.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 肖 (phonetic サク) + blade (刂) — shaved away: to whittle, cut down.
mnemonic: Shavings curling off the pencil — けずる. 削除: whittled to zero — delete.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — pressed until it yields: to squeeze, exploit.
mnemonic: The press coming down — しぼる. 搾取: squeezing people, economics' ugly word.

etymology: Pictograph: hands twisting rope — the cord; following it hand over hand: to search (検索).
mnemonic: Pull the rope till the answer surfaces — サク. 検索: this kanji, every time you google.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 昔 (phonetic サク) — inlaid metals crossing: interleaved, mixed up.
mnemonic: Gold and iron braided until no one can say which is which — サク. 錯覚: the senses' inlay error.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 最 (phonetic サツ) — pinching the moment out of time: to photograph.
mnemonic: The moment seized between two fingers — とる. 撮影: the shutter kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 察 (phonetic サツ) — surface against surface: to rub, scrape.
mnemonic: The hand that polishes and the knee that pays — する, こする. 摩擦: friction, physical and diplomatic.

components: cover with four people under it
etymology: Pictograph: the canopy with people and ribs beneath — an umbrella.
mnemonic: The kanji IS the drawing — かさ. 傘: four strangers sharing one in a downpour.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 参 (phonetic サン) — the heart pierced by the scene: miserable, cruel.
mnemonic: What you wish you hadn't gone (参) to see — みじめ. 悲惨: the accident-report adjective.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 戔 (phonetic サン) — planking over the void: scaffold, wharf.
mnemonic: Boards where there was only air — サン. 桟橋: the pier's plank walk.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 斬 'cut' (phonetic ザン) + 日 — a slice of time: a while.
mnemonic: A day cut short on purpose — しばらく. 暫く: 'see you in a slice'.

etymology: Compound: the successor named aloud (口) from the registry (冊) by authority (司) — the heir.
mnemonic: The name read from the family book — シ. 嗣ぐ: to carry the register on.

etymology: Phono-semantic: the banner radical + 也 (phonetic シ/セ) — carried out under the standard: to administer, bestow.
mnemonic: Under the flag, works distributed — ほどこす. 施設: what administration builds.

etymology: Compound: the spoon (匕) at something sweet — tasty; the taste of a statement: its gist.
mnemonic: One spoonful tells you everything — うまい, むね. 要旨: the dish reduced to its flavor.

etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 止 (phonetic シ) — blessing that comes to rest on one: welfare.
mnemonic: Fortune told to stay put — シ. 福祉: blessing, institutionalized.
